verdict.rationale: Nix is a CLI package manager, so machine-readable command output is a fair axis for it. However, the evidence pack only lists commands such as nix search, nix build, nix develop and nix why-depends, and never documents a JSON or other structured output mode for any of them. The probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI endpoints, and those would not count toward CLI JSON output anyway.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get machine-readable (JSON) output from core commands so an agent can parse results instead of scraping text
